note: Pilot task: nested out-and-back. A short excursion with a recent revisit, then a much longer one on a clearly different bearing, so the anchor has to survive a second excursion to be recognised again. Ages must leave room for the two 180 deg turns each excursion needs: at the medium yaw tier those alone cost ~8 s, which is why a 10 s age is impossible for this family and belongs to rotate_away_return.
